messages:
maria: FYI — trivy CI on inventory-service PR #412 failed at the policy validation step, looks like suppression schema mismatch.

maria: CI log snippet:```
2026-08-02T14:30:21Z ERROR policy-validate: suppression.yml: unknown key 'ignore' (expected 'exceptions')
Exited with code 1
```

scanner-bot: Workflow run failed: <https://ci.redwood.example/runs/38291|ci/trivy-run> (trivy v0.42.1) :rotating_light:

ajay: Oof. Did someone change the global suppression format when we onboarded the Snyk/GHAS mapping? I remember a change to use `exceptions` instead of `ignore`.

riley: We did push a change to the central scanner-config library last month to normalize to `exceptions:` (it lets GHAS + Snyk share the same exception IDs). Most repos were migrated but inventory-service was on the old per-repo format.

maria: Right, the repo has an older suppression.yml that looks like:```
ignore:
  - CVE-2024-9999: low risk, vendor accepted
```
And trivy policy-validate now rejects `ignore:`.

ajay: For a short-term unblock can we update the policy linter to accept both keys? Or add a shim in the CI job that converts `ignore` -> `exceptions` before validation.

riley: Prefer not to change the linter long-term. I can push a tiny migration script in the repo: `scripts/migrate-suppression.sh` that rewrites the key. Then we can open a follow-up to standardize across org.

maria: Sounds good. Also while we're triaging: inventory-service uses alpine:3.18 base and Snyk flagged CVE-2026-1234 (HIGH) in musl. That needs an image bump ASAP. Prioritizing that over low severity dependency bumps.

ajay: Agreed — bump base image in the PR and re-run full scan. If CVE-2026-1234 is fixed by alpine:3.19+ we should target that. I can open a quick patch PR to the dockerfile.

riley: Action items:
- riley: add migrate script + one-time commit to repo (will include README note)
- ajay: open image bump PR for alpine -> 3.19 and link to this thread
- maria: temporarily allow CI to skip `policy-validate` on PRs from forks (we keep it on main) until migration lands. We should do this as a short-lived exception only.

maria: For the policy skip I can change the workflow to gate on `if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == 'redwood/inventory-service' && github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]'` — basically only skip for this repo's PRs from external forks. Thoughts?

ajay: That condition works. Add an expiry comment in the workflow and raise a Jira ticket for the migration so SRE can track.

riley: Also we should update the scanner-config upstream docs and add a linter rule in devex that warns on `ignore:` usage during pre-commit. Prevent future drift.

maria: I'll file the Jira: SEC-7342 "migrate suppression.yml format for inventory-service + unblock CI" and include these steps.

scanner-bot: Noted — rerun scheduled once PRs updated.

ajay: Quick FYI: Snyk project mapping is another source of duplicate alerts. Once migration and bump are done I'll reconcile Snyk project IDs so we don't get duplicated GHAS+Snyk exceptions for the same CVE.

maria: Perfect. If anyone hits more failed scans from the template mismatch, ping me. I'll keep the ticket updated and revert the CI skip once the migration is merged. :white_check_mark:
